INCIDENT: notes is down after this morning's deploy
====================================================
Everything is in the namespace notes. Each part was captured after the
fix before it was applied.

The release page lists these podinfo 6.9 tags: 6.9.0, 6.9.1, 6.9.2.
The team wanted the newest.
